name: @axo/api-worker
description: Axo API Worker, Durable Objects, and runtime tests

scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:relay
scripts.test:core: npm --prefix ../axo-api run schema:check && npm run typecheck && tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/api.test.ts tests/hosts.test.ts tests/lifecycle.test.ts tests/limits.test.ts tests/machines.test.ts tests/observability.test.ts tests/replies.property.test.ts tests/replies.test.ts
scripts.test:relay: npm --prefix ../axo-api run build && npm --prefix ../axo-api run schema:check && (cd ../.. && bazel build //crates/axod:axod) && AXOD_BINARY=../../bazel-bin/crates/axod/axod tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/axod-relay.test.ts
